request_user:
Fact: data_bias_measures
What to find: Measures to detect or address identifiable biases in the training data, or known biases.
Card sections that often contain it: Bias, Risks and Limitations, Training Data

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Known biases: model may over- or under-represent groups, erase representation of some groups, or reinforce stereotypes due to differing representation and negative stereotypes in training data reflecting societal biases, despite safety post-training. English language varieties with less representation may perform worse. Training data was meticulously filtered and improved.
quotes: **Representation of Harms & Perpetuation of Stereotypes:** The model may over- or under-represent groups of people, erase representation of some groups, or reinforce demeaning or negative stereotypes. Despite safety post-training, these limitations may still be present due to differing levels of representation of different groups or prevalence of examples of negative stereotypes in training data that reflect real-world patterns and societal biases.
English language varieties with less representation in the training data might experience worse performance than standard American English.
The training data consists primarily of meticulously filtered and improved open-source vision-language datasets
